Reason: the gallery loads every entry's CSS on every route, and other entries declare EB Garamond, Hanken Grotesk, Albert Sans and Syne at weights this source never loads, so bold text rendered with real bold faces instead of the browser's synthesized bold, and an unweighted Syne quote rendered at 400 instead of falling back to 700. Fontshare returns Boska and Satoshi for this request and no Switzer, so /4's Switzer text falls back to sans-serif in both.

globals.css adds browser-default restores (`margin: revert` on paragraphs, headings and other block elements; margin, padding and list-style on lists; margin, padding, border, radius, background and color on form controls) because the gallery's Tailwind preflight resets them and the source has no Tailwind.
